name: Wit of the Hedge Maze
body:
School transmutation; Level: jester 4

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: 1 round

DESCRIPTION

Until the end of the combat, you can use ranged attacks as if they were melee attacks. When used as a melee attack, they have a reach of 5 feet. These attacks do not provoke attacks of opportunity.
